scripts.deploy: npm run build:firebase && npx --yes firebase-tools@15.29.0 deploy
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm run build:firebase && npx --yes firebase-tools@15.29.0 deploy --only hosting
scripts.test: tsx --test lib/ledger.test.ts lib/date.test.ts lib/activateLease.test.ts lib/ownerFinancials.test.ts lib/stage4.test.ts lib/console-home.test.ts
scripts.test:emulators: npx --yes firebase-tools@15.29.0 emulators:exec --project demo-nlr-integrity --config firebase.test.json --only firestore,auth,storage "tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/integrity.test.ts"
scripts.test:browser: npx --yes firebase-tools@15.29.0 emulators:exec --project demo-nlr-integrity --config firebase.test.json --only firestore,auth,storage "node tests/run-browser.cjs"
scripts.build:firebase: npm run lint && next build && npm run verify:release
